artifact: CityMETER Transit — 3D-first, rail-first map of lines, stations and interchanges
layoutReference: https://montri-th.github.io/luxurybrands/ (CityMETER map layout: header 48 px, full map, right panel, collapsible chart tray, mobile bottom sheet)
styleReference: pmndrs raycast-cycling example (https://pmndrs.github.io/examples/raycast-cycling/): translucent white solids, soft baked shadow, hover pulse, cycling of stacked hits with status dots

colors.applied: assets/theme.css — foundation pairs, map roles, data states, categorical series 1–10 (fill and ink), count classes; --basemap-* and --scene-* are context tokens declared once, never data
colors.analytical: js/scales.js — count and activity families, exact 41-sample LUTs, identical HEX on both themes; classes round(i×40/(n−1))

lineIdentity.rule: line colours are third-party identity (the colour in the line's own name) with a source per line
lineIdentity.primary: OpenStreetMap route relation `colour` (colorBasis osm_route_colour); an extension takes its line family colour (osm_route_colour_of_line_family)
lineIdentity.fallback: LDS categorical token nearest to the named colour family (colorBasis lds-series-fallback, resolved per theme)
lineIdentity.status: exception to the LDS categorical palette approved by the owner 2026-10-31 (DATA_METHOD.md §7)

firstAha: number of interchange complexes (records joined by current relations of 31_INTERCHANGES) on the operating network, the hubs that join the most lines (ties by reach), and the stations under construction; the first paint frames those hubs in the 3D city preset
grainContract: one record = one station–line (17_RAIL_CATALOG) or one station–project (23_CONSTRUCTION_STATIONS); never merged across lines; complexes group records for pins and plates only
statusContract: operator roster listed → เปิดให้บริการ; project membership → กำลังก่อสร้าง; existing/junction project members → ยังยืนยันไม่ได้; target dates are targets; project progress is not station progress

mapContract.scene: js/scene.js — one MapLibre custom layer (three.js 0.186.1): ribbons per line and level (elevated 12 m, surface 0.6 m, underground 0.3 m, ramps of 200 m), instanced piers from zoom 14.5, station plates by role (hub/station) striped with the lines that meet, OSM station buildings, focus massing; depth cleared before the scene so data never hides behind basemap massing
mapContract.lines2d: js/map-layers.js — 2D lines below zoom 10 or with 3D off; construction dashed; quiet grey outside the focus
mapContract.pins: js/pins.js — HTML buttons for keyboard and screen readers; one pin per complex within 150 m
mapContract.elevation: from OpenStreetMap ways of the same line (route relation members and ways that name the line); unknown when unmatched
mapContract.optionalLayers: other modes in the "ขนส่งอื่น" menu, off by default, lazy-loaded (data/bus.json, boat.json, layer-moto/intercity/srt/air.json): bus corridors (width by GTFS route-count class) + stops + BRT, boat routes (dashed) + piers (rings), conventional rail stops (filled square), intercity terminals (diamond; hollow = บขส. stop), motorcycle-taxi stands (small triangle), airports (plane); quiet map-role tokens, shape tells the mode; route lines above the road casing and below the rail lines; counts and sources in meta.contextLayers
mapContract.camera: plan / city (56/28) / model (60, FOV 14) / eye (75, FOV 24) with pitch ≤ 90 − fov/2 − 3
mapContract.stationFrame: a click on a station (panel, pin or 3D object) fits the ring of STATION_RADIUS_M (450 m, = focus massing) with roof heights (loaded massing, else a 60 m framing allowance) to the visible map area (pitchedPadding on desktop, cameraPadding above the mobile sheet); camera.fitPitched with recenter uses the padded area as principal point; one refit when taller roofs load unless the user moved the camera
mapContract.construction: construction alignments dashed in 2D (line-dasharray) and in 3D (dashPath, 14 px on / 9 px off at the current scale)

chartContract: lines: stations per line (count classes); status: operating vs construction with shape cues; ridership: one comparable series at a time (metric + unit + period + aggregation), switchable, activity LUT; every mark is a button
copy: short natural Thai; units สถานี (station–line record) / สาย / จุดเปลี่ยนสาย; provenance short and factual (period · source link · coordinate role); methodology in DATA_METHOD.md
accessibility: keyboard reachable pins, charts and panel; visible focus; reduced motion honoured; Thai and English checked at 390 px and desktop in light and dark
publication: no Google Drive/Docs links, local paths or credentials in published files (build guard + tests); release on main after the gate; npm run verify:live before claiming a release
stationNearby: station panel "ขนส่งอื่นรอบสถานี": per layer, points within 500 m of the station reference point and the nearest one (straight line, not walking); outside a layer boundary = นอกขอบเขตข้อมูล, never zero
